work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCCXX, addressed to the bishop of Lecce (LF59723–59724), commissions him to let Giovanni Balsamo and his household satisfy the Mass precept from the gallery of his house overlooking the rebuilt chapel, without immunity for the house, and ends with its own 11 April 1834 closing at LF59794, before numeral CCCXXI at LF59797. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF59727–59727; the source closing at LF59791–59794 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima prima aprilis millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quarto, pon- tificatus Nostri anno quarto. LF59766 (1 Ex BulJlario Romano,) is its own provenance note, excluded with page number 390 and the head-margin specks LF59772 (° *). Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
